mechanism_narrative: Positive GDPC1 growth signals expanding economic activity, increasing corporate earnings expectations and boosting equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth exceeds 0.5% quarterly but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS rate exceeding 0.25% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 0.25% but 5-day returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances over 2016-2024.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline indicate strengthening labor market conditions, driving consumer spending and positive equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.1pp but 60-day returns are negative in > 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO decline below 99.0 in late-cycle expansion signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 99.0 in late-cycle but 20-day returns are positive in > 45% of cases over 2016-2024.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 238.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 238.0 but 5-day returns are positive in > 50% of cases over 2016-2024.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1170 thousand units signals housing market strength, boosting consumer confidence and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1170 but 20-day returns are negative in > 55% of cases over 2016-2024.

mechanism_narrative: Joint HOUST growth and RSAFS expansion indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1170 and RSAFS growth > 0.3% but 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE below 5.0% during early-cycle expansion signals tight labor markets, increasing wage pressures and positive equity returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0% in early-cycle but 5-day returns are negative in > 40% of cases over 2016-2024.
